title: Key rotation
blockedByMigration: Finish the interrupted master key rotation first.

identity.title: Identity key
identity.description: A new key derived from your wallet signature; the master key is re-sealed to it. Files are untouched.
identity.confirm: Rotate your identity key? You will sign twice and send one transaction.

masterKey.title: Master key
masterKey.description: A new master key; every file key is re-wrapped under it. Can be resumed if interrupted.
masterKey.confirm: Rotate your master key? This sends several transactions; if interrupted, you can resume after unlocking.

full.title: Full re-encryption
full.description: Every file is downloaded, re-encrypted under a new file key and uploaded again. The slowest and most thorough.
full.confirm: Re-encrypt all files? Each file costs two transactions and is downloaded and uploaded again.

banner.title: Unfinished master key rotation
banner.inProgress: A master key rotation was interrupted. Your files are safe — some are already on the new key. Continue to finish it.
banner.needsCleanup: The new master key is active; one cleanup transaction is still missing.
banner.unreadable: A parked master key exists but cannot be opened with your current identity key. Do not clear it — contact support.

subtitle: Replace keys if you suspect one was exposed. Each step is safe to resume.
